capacities.description: Internet reachability for customer-owned address prefixes announced by a provider.
Authorization and validation of prefix origination.

facts: A provider offers a service that announces customer-owned IP prefixes from its network locations.
Internet route acceptance depends on BGP announcements and external authorization/validation records.
Service bindings can direct traffic for specific addresses toward different provider services.
Analysts must identify boundaries, route relations, alternatives, support dependencies, and selective failure predictions.
forbidden_outcome_material: withdrawal counts, timing, and affected-service results
identity_prompt: Specify the organization whose continued operation would count as continuity of the protected service, without using UCIC terminology.
